900.3.10(234).explanation: Exception RD 234 sets a 1.2 m minimum side yard setback, a 5.7 m minimum setback from a side lot line abutting a street, and a 22.0 m front setback measured from the original road-allowance centreline for lots fronting Midland Ave. (the last is disclosed, not applied). No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(13).explanation: Exception RD 13 sets a 2.1 m minimum front yard setback, a 7.5 m minimum rear yard setback (10.5 m where the rear lot line abuts Kipling Ave. or Steeles Ave.), a 0.6 m minimum side yard setback (2.1 m on a lot flanking a street), a 3-storey height limit, maintenance easement and fence rules, and a 4.5 m street-line setback for garages and other ancillary buildings. No prevailing by-laws apply.

900.3.10(1329).explanation: Exception RD 1329 lets a building existing on February 28, 1977 be replaced at its existing height, lets a pre-1953 detached house on a 0.6 FSI lot add to the rear up to 0.69 FSI under conditions, bars upper-level platforms from encroaching into required front or rear yards, and bars a front-wall vehicle entrance on lots with 7.6 m or less of frontage. No prevailing by-laws apply.
